segments.t: In pain from his chronic stomach trouble, Chun Yuqiao calls out from his office to shut the door. Bu Xiaogu steps inside to close it — and promptly gets ordered back out into the corridor. Listen first.
出了点问题，我解决一下。
关门，关门！
谁让你进来的？
您没事吧？我是布小谷。
我说的关门，是在外边把门关上。
出去！
你在这儿干吗？
不是说过实习生不许进总编室吗？
跟你开玩笑的，说说。
Let's look at every line of this awkward doorway mix-up.
出了点问题，我解决一下。
'A small problem came up; I will take care of it.' Notice "chu le dian wenti", literally 'came out a bit of problem', paired with "jiejue", the go-to workplace word for solving an issue.
关门，关门！
'Close the door, close the door!' Two crisp characters — "guan", 'shut', plus "men", 'door' — repeated twice show urgency without wasting a single syllable.
谁让你进来的？
'Who told you to come in?' Framing "shei rang ni... de" with "shei", 'who', and "rang", 'let' or 'tell', demands to know who gave permission for what just happened.
您没事吧？我是布小谷。
'Are you alright? I am Bu Xiaogu.' Polite concern in Mandarin sounds like "nin meishi ba?", literally 'you have no trouble, right?', where "meishi" covers 'it's fine' and 'unhurt'.
我说的关门，是在外边把门关上。

'When I said close the door, I meant close it from the outside.' Compare compact "guan men" with "ba men guanshang": "ba" puts the door first, and "shang" emphasizes latching it shut from "waibian", 'outside'.
出去！
'Get out!' Earlier we heard "jinlai" for 'come in'; flip both parts to "chu", 'exit', plus "qu", 'go away from me', and you get blunt "chuqu", 'go out!'.
你在这儿干吗？
'What are you doing here?' Spoken "ganma" (with second-tone "ma") is the brisk everyday way to ask 'what are you up to?' right after location "zai zher", 'here'.
不是说过实习生不许进总编室吗？
'Did you not say interns are not allowed inside the chief editor's office?' Framing a reminder with "bushi... ma?" means 'didn't you say...?', while "buxu" states a strict rule: 'not permitted'.
跟你开玩笑的，说说。

'I was joking with you — go ahead and tell me.' He softens his tone with "gen ni kai wanxiao de" ('just kidding with you') and doubled "shuoshuo" ('tell me briefly'), inviting Xiaogu to pitch her idea. Now let's listen to the whole doorway encounter again.
出了点问题，我解决一下。
关门，关门！
谁让你进来的？
您没事吧？我是布小谷。
我说的关门，是在外边把门关上。
出去！
你在这儿干吗？
不是说过实习生不许进总编室吗？
跟你开玩笑的，说说。
Once Chun Yuqiao steps into the hallway, he actually listens to what the intern came to say. You learned "guan men", opposite direction pair "jinlai" and "chuqu", and "nin meishi ba?".
再见！
